title: Towards Accessible AI Research for Complex Batch Biochemical Processes
summary: A research pipeline for batch biochemical/chemical process data that provides a privacy-preserving preprocessing pipeline (PPPP), benchmark datasets, and spatiotemporal kinetic modeling for reproducible AI research. Its PPPP dataset-generation stage imports CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and Condition from SDV's single_table and sampling modules to synthesize privacy-preserving batch process data.
evidence: PPPP/utils/loader.py:11-13 imports CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and Condition from sdv for its privacy-preserving pipeline
